🇩🇪 CRISTAL Lab Open Roles

Location: Germany
Hiring Organization: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security is launching the CRISTAL Lab and recruiting fully funded PhD Students, Postdoctoral Researchers, and Research Interns to join the founding team in Germany.

CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security is launching the CRISTAL Lab, focusing on Communication, Reasoning, Intelligence & Safety for Trustworthy ALignment. The lab is recruiting fully funded PhD Students, Postdoctoral Researchers, and Research Interns to join the founding team.

Research areas of interest include AI Alignment & Agentic Reasoning, Safety, Robustness & Evaluation, and Transparent & Adaptable Intelligence. For more information, visit https://t.co/nTJLPUeXUT (https://t.co/X6rMW9CUVa).

• Founding Lab Culture with direct 1:1 mentorship and full research autonomy
• Full Institutional Support & Compute with access to dedicated computational infrastructure and conference travel funding
• Vibrant European Hub with competitive full-time salary and benefits in an international, English-speaking environment
To apply, follow the guidelines at https://t.co/nTJLPUeXUT (https://t.co/X6rMW9CUVa). For quick questions or potential research collaborations, contact Cristina Garbacea at garbacea@uchicago.edu.

#CRISTALLab #CISPA #AIAlignment
chinese_translation: 德国CISPA Helmholtz信息安全中心正在启动CRISTAL实验室，招聘全额资助博士生、博士后和研究实习生加入创始团队。实验室聚焦可信对齐的沟通、推理、智能与安全。研究方向包括AI对齐与代理推理、安全、鲁棒性与评估、透明与适应性智能。提供1:1导师指导、研究自主、专用计算资源、会议资助、有竞争力薪资。申请详见链接，联系Cristina Garbacea (garbacea@uchicago.edu)。
application_notes: Fully funded; Contact garbacea@uchicago.edu; See application guidelines in link
